//============================================================
// Auto-generated Metal MBSRAF + DenseOPC + OPCVerify deck
// Input: {input_oas_path}
//============================================================

LAYOUT SYSTEM GDSII
LAYOUT PATH "{input_oas_path}"
LAYOUT PRIMARY "*"

LAYOUT ERROR ON INPUT YES
LAYOUT MAGNIFY AUTO

PRECISION 10000
RESOLUTION 1
UNIT LENGTH U

DRC RESULTS DATABASE "{output_oas_path}" GDSII PSEUDO
DRC SUMMARY REPORT "calibre_summary.rep"
DRC MAXIMUM RESULTS ALL
DRC MAXIMUM VERTEX 4000

//============================================================
// 1. Metal target and initial mask
//============================================================

LAYER METAL_TARGET 9 0

METAL_TARGET { COPY METAL_TARGET }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_TARGET 30

// For the first experiment, use the design target as the MBSRAF reference
// mask. Replace this COPY with a retarget/pre-bias operation when needed.
METAL_INIT = COPY METAL_TARGET

METAL_INIT { COPY METAL_INIT }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_INIT 31

//============================================================
// 2. Model-based SRAF generation
//============================================================

METAL_SRAF_INITIAL = RET MBSRAF METAL_TARGET METAL_INIT FILE MBSRAF_SETUP MAP SB_RESULT

METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { COPY METAL_SRAF_INITIAL }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_SRAF_INITIAL 41



LITHO FILE MBSRAF_SETUP [
    processing_mode flat
    progress_meter off

    modelpath /home/anonymous/zeroshot-jobs/resources

    layer SRAF_TARGET
    layer INITIAL_MASK

    tilemicrons 5
    simulation_consistency 2

    image_options METAL_SRAF_MODEL {
        litho_model models
        layer INITIAL_MASK visible
    }

    sraf_options METAL_SRAF_OPTS {
        algorithm 1
        correctionlayer INITIAL_MASK
        image_options METAL_SRAF_MODEL

        minwidth 0.03
        maxwidth 0.035
        maxlength 0.1
        extension 0.02
        minlength 0.08
        minsquarelength 0.045
        minoffset 0.05
        maxoffset 0.3
        minfeaturespace 0.05
        collecttype 0
        # algorithm 1 owns corner preference and placement mode.  Explicit
        # overrides were ignored by Calibre 2022.2 and obscured provenance.
        localmaxgradient width 0.03 prior 1
    }

    setlayer SB_RESULT = mbsraf SRAF_TARGET OPTIONS METAL_SRAF_OPTS

]

//============================================================
// 3. DenseOPC: main feature movable; SRAF is simulated and print-avoided
//============================================================

METAL_DENSE_FINAL = LITHO DENSEOPC METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL FILE NMOPC_SETUP MAP METAL_FINAL_RESULT

// Main OPC polygons retain interaction with the design target; corrected
// SRAFs remain disjoint.  This deterministic split ensures the SRAF returned
// by print avoidance, rather than the original MBSRAF input, enters final mask.
METAL_OPC = INTERACT METAL_DENSE_FINAL METAL_TARGET
METAL_SRAF = NOT METAL_DENSE_FINAL METAL_OPC

METAL_OPC { COPY METAL_OPC }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_OPC 101

METAL_FINAL_MASK = COPY METAL_DENSE_FINAL

METAL_SRAF { COPY METAL_SRAF }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_SRAF 40

METAL_FINAL_MASK { COPY METAL_FINAL_MASK }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_FINAL_MASK 102

LITHO FILE NMOPC_SETUP [
    modelpath /home/anonymous/zeroshot-jobs/resources/models

    layer METAL_TARGET
    layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL

    tilemicrons 5 adjust
    processing_mode flat
    contour_options interp_algo lagrange interp_degree 5
    simulation_consistency 2

    denseopc_options METAL_OPTS {
        version 1

        jog_freeze 0.010
        jog_ignore_metric 0.007
        max_opc_move 0.05
        max_iter_movement 0.005

        layer METAL_TARGET opc
        # A hidden layer is not simulated.  SRAF must use the documented
        # sraf type so sraf_print_avoidance can detect and correct printing.
        layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL sraf

        image /
        pw_condition SRAF_PRINT dose 1 spa

        feedback_mode 1
        displacement_limit_mode STRICT

        fragment_min 0.025
        line_end_fragment off
        fragment_layer_order full
        fragment_max 0.060 -minlen 0.200
        fragment_corner convex convex length > 0.050 < 0.100 fragment breakinhalf
        fragment_corner convex convex length >= 0.100 fragment 0.050 0.040 0.030 0.025
        fragment_layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL {
            fragment_min 0.02
            fragment_max 0.08
        }

        mrc_rule external METAL_TARGET { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule external METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule internal METAL_TARGET { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule internal METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule area METAL_SRAF_INITIAL {
            use 0.0016
            square use 0.0004
        }

        feedback -0.3 -0.4 -0.5 -0.6 -0.7 -0.6 -0.5 -0.4 -0.3 -0.2

        sraf_sites_create -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL
        OPC_ITERATION 5
        OPC_ITERATION 1
        sraf_print_avoidance -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL -step 0.001
        OPC_ITERATION 1
        sraf_print_avoidance -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL -step 0.001
        OPC_ITERATION 1
        sraf_print_avoidance -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL -step 0.001
        OPC_ITERATION 2
    }

    # These setlayer calls are concurrent output mappings of one DenseOPC run.
    setlayer METAL_OPC_RESULT = denseopc METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL MAP METAL_TARGET OPTIONS METAL_OPTS
    setlayer METAL_SRAF_RESULT = denseopc METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL MAP METAL_SRAF_INITIAL OPTIONS METAL_OPTS
    setlayer METAL_FINAL_RESULT = or METAL_OPC_RESULT METAL_SRAF_RESULT
]

// Auto-generated Metal MBSRAF + DenseOPC + OPCVerify deck
// Input: {input_oas_path}
//============================================================

LAYOUT PATH "{input_oas_path}"

LAYOUT ERROR ON INPUT YES
LAYOUT MAGNIFY AUTO

PRECISION 10000
RESOLUTION 1
UNIT LENGTH U

DRC RESULTS DATABASE "{output_oas_path}" GDSII PSEUDO
DRC SUMMARY REPORT "calibre_summary.rep"
DRC MAXIMUM RESULTS ALL
DRC MAXIMUM VERTEX 4000

//============================================================
// 1. Metal target and initial mask
//============================================================

LAYER METAL_TARGET 9 0

METAL_TARGET { COPY METAL_TARGET }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_TARGET 30

// For the first experiment, use the design target as the MBSRAF reference
// mask. Replace this COPY with a retarget/pre-bias operation when needed.
METAL_INIT = COPY METAL_TARGET

METAL_INIT { COPY METAL_INIT }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_INIT 31

//============================================================
// 2. Model-based SRAF generation
//============================================================

METAL_SRAF_INITIAL = RET MBSRAF METAL_TARGET METAL_INIT FILE MBSRAF_SETUP MAP SB_RESULT

METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { COPY METAL_SRAF_INITIAL }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_SRAF_INITIAL 41



LITHO FILE MBSRAF_SETUP [
    processing_mode flat
    progress_meter off

    modelpath /home/anonymous/zeroshot-jobs/resources

    layer SRAF_TARGET
    layer INITIAL_MASK

    tilemicrons 5
    simulation_consistency 2

    image_options METAL_SRAF_MODEL {
        litho_model models
        layer INITIAL_MASK visible
    }

    sraf_options METAL_SRAF_OPTS {
        algorithm 1
        correctionlayer INITIAL_MASK
        image_options METAL_SRAF_MODEL

        minwidth 0.03
        maxwidth 0.035
        maxlength 0.1
        extension 0.02
        minlength 0.08
        minsquarelength 0.045
        minoffset 0.05
        maxoffset 0.3
        minfeaturespace 0.05
        collecttype 0
        # algorithm 1 owns corner preference and placement mode.  Explicit
        # overrides were ignored by Calibre 2022.2 and obscured provenance.
        localmaxgradient width 0.03 prior 1
    }

    setlayer SB_RESULT = mbsraf SRAF_TARGET OPTIONS METAL_SRAF_OPTS

]

//============================================================
// 3. DenseOPC: main feature movable; SRAF is simulated and print-avoided
//============================================================

METAL_DENSE_FINAL = LITHO DENSEOPC METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL FILE NMOPC_SETUP MAP METAL_FINAL_RESULT

// Main OPC polygons retain interaction with the design target; corrected
// SRAFs remain disjoint.  This deterministic split ensures the SRAF returned
// by print avoidance, rather than the original MBSRAF input, enters final mask.
METAL_OPC = INTERACT METAL_DENSE_FINAL METAL_TARGET
METAL_SRAF = NOT METAL_DENSE_FINAL METAL_OPC

METAL_OPC { COPY METAL_OPC }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_OPC 101

METAL_FINAL_MASK = COPY METAL_DENSE_FINAL

METAL_SRAF { COPY METAL_SRAF }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_SRAF 40

METAL_FINAL_MASK { COPY METAL_FINAL_MASK }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_FINAL_MASK 102

LITHO FILE NMOPC_SETUP [
    modelpath /home/anonymous/zeroshot-jobs/resources/models

    layer METAL_TARGET
    layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL

    tilemicrons 5 adjust
    processing_mode flat
    contour_options interp_algo lagrange interp_degree 5
    simulation_consistency 2

    denseopc_options METAL_OPTS {
        version 1

        jog_freeze 0.010
        jog_ignore_metric 0.007
        max_opc_move 0.06
        max_iter_movement 0.004

        layer METAL_TARGET opc
        # A hidden layer is not simulated.  SRAF must use the documented
        # sraf type so sraf_print_avoidance can detect and correct printing.
        layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL sraf

        image /
        pw_condition SRAF_PRINT dose 1 spa

        feedback_mode 1
        displacement_limit_mode STRICT

        fragment_min 0.025
        line_end_fragment off
        fragment_layer_order full
        fragment_max 0.060 -minlen 0.200
        fragment_corner convex convex length > 0.050 < 0.100 fragment breakinhalf
        fragment_corner convex convex length >= 0.100 fragment 0.050 0.040 0.030 0.025
        fragment_layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL {
            fragment_min 0.02
            fragment_max 0.08
        }

        mrc_rule external METAL_TARGET { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule external METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule internal METAL_TARGET { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule internal METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule area METAL_SRAF_INITIAL {

        }

        OPC_ITERATION 7

        OPC_ITERATION 1
        sraf_print_avoidance -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL -step 0.001
        OPC_ITERATION 1

    setlayer METAL_FINAL_RESULT = or METAL_OPC_RESULT METAL_SRAF_RESULT

// Auto-generated Metal MBSRAF + DenseOPC + OPCVerify deck
// Input: {input_oas_path}
//============================================================

LAYOUT SYSTEM GDSII
LAYOUT PATH "{input_oas_path}"
LAYOUT PRIMARY "*"

LAYOUT ERROR ON INPUT YES
LAYOUT MAGNIFY AUTO

PRECISION 10000
RESOLUTION 1
UNIT LENGTH U

DRC RESULTS DATABASE "{output_oas_path}" GDSII PSEUDO
DRC SUMMARY REPORT "calibre_summary.rep"
DRC MAXIMUM RESULTS ALL
DRC MAXIMUM VERTEX 4000

//============================================================
// 1. Metal target and initial mask
//============================================================

LAYER METAL_TARGET 9 0

METAL_TARGET { COPY METAL_TARGET }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_TARGET 30

// For the first experiment, use the design target as the MBSRAF reference
// mask. Replace this COPY with a retarget/pre-bias operation when needed.
METAL_INIT = COPY METAL_TARGET

METAL_INIT { COPY METAL_INIT }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_INIT 31

//============================================================
// 2. Model-based SRAF generation
//============================================================

METAL_SRAF_INITIAL = RET MBSRAF METAL_TARGET METAL_INIT FILE MBSRAF_SETUP MAP SB_RESULT

METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { COPY METAL_SRAF_INITIAL }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_SRAF_INITIAL 41



LITHO FILE MBSRAF_SETUP [
    processing_mode flat
    progress_meter off

    modelpath /home/anonymous/zeroshot-jobs/resources

    layer SRAF_TARGET
    layer INITIAL_MASK

    tilemicrons 5
    simulation_consistency 2

    image_options METAL_SRAF_MODEL {
        litho_model models
        layer INITIAL_MASK visible
    }

    sraf_options METAL_SRAF_OPTS {
        algorithm 1
        correctionlayer INITIAL_MASK
        image_options METAL_SRAF_MODEL

        minwidth 0.03
        maxwidth 0.035
        maxlength 0.1
        extension 0.02
        minlength 0.08
        minsquarelength 0.045
        minoffset 0.05
        maxoffset 0.3
        minfeaturespace 0.05
        collecttype 0
        # algorithm 1 owns corner preference and placement mode.  Explicit
        # overrides were ignored by Calibre 2022.2 and obscured provenance.
        localmaxgradient width 0.03 prior 1
    }

    setlayer SB_RESULT = mbsraf SRAF_TARGET OPTIONS METAL_SRAF_OPTS

]

//============================================================
// 3. DenseOPC: main feature movable; SRAF is simulated and print-avoided
//============================================================

METAL_DENSE_FINAL = LITHO DENSEOPC METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL FILE NMOPC_SETUP MAP METAL_FINAL_RESULT

// Main OPC polygons retain interaction with the design target; corrected
// SRAFs remain disjoint.  This deterministic split ensures the SRAF returned
// by print avoidance, rather than the original MBSRAF input, enters final mask.
METAL_OPC = INTERACT METAL_DENSE_FINAL METAL_TARGET
METAL_SRAF = NOT METAL_DENSE_FINAL METAL_OPC

METAL_OPC { COPY METAL_OPC }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_OPC 101

METAL_FINAL_MASK = COPY METAL_DENSE_FINAL

METAL_SRAF { COPY METAL_SRAF }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_SRAF 40

METAL_FINAL_MASK { COPY METAL_FINAL_MASK }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_FINAL_MASK 102

LITHO FILE NMOPC_SETUP [
    modelpath /home/anonymous/zeroshot-jobs/resources/models

    layer METAL_TARGET
    layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL

    tilemicrons 5 adjust
    processing_mode flat
    contour_options interp_algo lagrange interp_degree 5
    simulation_consistency 2

    denseopc_options METAL_OPTS {
        version 1

        jog_freeze 0.005
        jog_ignore_metric 0.007
        max_opc_move 0.05
        max_iter_movement 0.003

        layer METAL_TARGET opc
        # A hidden layer is not simulated.  SRAF must use the documented
        # sraf type so sraf_print_avoidance can detect and correct printing.
        layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL sraf

        image /
        pw_condition SRAF_PRINT dose 1 spa

        feedback_mode 1
        displacement_limit_mode STRICT

        fragment_min 0.025
        line_end_fragment off
        fragment_layer_order full
        fragment_max 0.040
        fragment_corner convex convex length > 0.050 < 0.100 fragment breakinhalf
        fragment_corner convex convex length >= 0.100 fragment 0.050 0.040 0.030 0.025
        fragment_layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL {
            fragment_min 0.02
            fragment_max 0.08
        }

        mrc_rule external METAL_TARGET { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule external METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule internal METAL_TARGET { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule internal METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule area METAL_SRAF_INITIAL {
            use 0.0016
            square use 0.0004
        }

        feedback -0.3 -0.4 -0.5 -0.6 -0.7 -0.8 -0.7 -0.6 -0.5 -0.4 -0.3 -0.2

        sraf_sites_create -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL
        OPC_ITERATION 7
        OPC_ITERATION 1
        sraf_print_avoidance -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL -step 0.001
        OPC_ITERATION 1
        sraf_print_avoidance -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL -step 0.001
        OPC_ITERATION 1
        sraf_print_avoidance -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL -step 0.001
        OPC_ITERATION 2
    }

    setlayer METAL_OPC_RESULT = denseopc METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL MAP METAL_TARGET OPTIONS METAL_OPTS
    setlayer METAL_SRAF_RESULT = denseopc METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL MAP METAL_SRAF_INITIAL OPTIONS METAL_OPTS
    setlayer METAL_FINAL_RESULT = or METAL_OPC_RESULT METAL_SRAF_RESULT

//============================================================
// Auto-generated Metal MBSRAF + DenseOPC + OPCVerify deck
// Input: {input_oas_path}
//============================================================

LAYOUT SYSTEM GDSII
LAYOUT PATH "{input_oas_path}"
LAYOUT PRIMARY "*"

LAYOUT ERROR ON INPUT YES
LAYOUT MAGNIFY AUTO

PRECISION 10000
RESOLUTION 1
UNIT LENGTH U

DRC RESULTS DATABASE "{output_oas_path}" GDSII PSEUDO
DRC SUMMARY REPORT "calibre_summary.rep"
DRC MAXIMUM RESULTS ALL
DRC MAXIMUM VERTEX 4000

//============================================================
// 1. Metal target and initial mask
//============================================================

LAYER METAL_TARGET 9 0

METAL_TARGET { COPY METAL_TARGET }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_TARGET 30

// For the first experiment, use the design target as the MBSRAF reference
// mask. Replace this COPY with a retarget/pre-bias operation when needed.
METAL_INIT = COPY METAL_TARGET

METAL_INIT { COPY METAL_INIT }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_INIT 31

//============================================================
// 2. Model-based SRAF generation
//============================================================

METAL_SRAF_INITIAL = RET MBSRAF METAL_TARGET METAL_INIT FILE MBSRAF_SETUP MAP SB_RESULT

METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { COPY METAL_SRAF_INITIAL }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_SRAF_INITIAL 41



LITHO FILE MBSRAF_SETUP [
    processing_mode flat
    progress_meter off

    modelpath /home/anonymous/zeroshot-jobs/resources

    layer SRAF_TARGET
    layer INITIAL_MASK

    tilemicrons 5
    simulation_consistency 2

    image_options METAL_SRAF_MODEL {
        litho_model models
        layer INITIAL_MASK visible
    }

    sraf_options METAL_SRAF_OPTS {
        algorithm 1
        correctionlayer INITIAL_MASK
        image_options METAL_SRAF_MODEL

        minwidth 0.03
        maxwidth 0.035
        maxlength 0.1
        extension 0.02
        minlength 0.08
        minsquarelength 0.045
        minoffset 0.05
        maxoffset 0.3
        minfeaturespace 0.05
        collecttype 0
        # algorithm 1 owns corner preference and placement mode.  Explicit
        # overrides were ignored by Calibre 2022.2 and obscured provenance.
        localmaxgradient width 0.03 prior 1
    }

    setlayer SB_RESULT = mbsraf SRAF_TARGET OPTIONS METAL_SRAF_OPTS

]

//============================================================
// 3. DenseOPC: main feature movable; SRAF is simulated and print-avoided
//============================================================

METAL_DENSE_FINAL = LITHO DENSEOPC METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL FILE NMOPC_SETUP MAP METAL_FINAL_RESULT

// Main OPC polygons retain interaction with the design target; corrected
// SRAFs remain disjoint.  This deterministic split ensures the SRAF returned
// by print avoidance, rather than the original MBSRAF input, enters final mask.
METAL_OPC = INTERACT METAL_DENSE_FINAL METAL_TARGET
METAL_SRAF = NOT METAL_DENSE_FINAL METAL_OPC

METAL_OPC { COPY METAL_OPC }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_OPC 101

METAL_FINAL_MASK = COPY METAL_DENSE_FINAL

METAL_SRAF { COPY METAL_SRAF }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_SRAF 40

METAL_FINAL_MASK { COPY METAL_FINAL_MASK }
DRC CHECK MAP METAL_FINAL_MASK 102

LITHO FILE NMOPC_SETUP [
    modelpath /home/anonymous/zeroshot-jobs/resources/models

    layer METAL_TARGET
    layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL

    tilemicrons 5 adjust
    processing_mode flat
    contour_options interp_algo lagrange interp_degree 5
    simulation_consistency 2

    denseopc_options METAL_OPTS {
        version 1

        jog_freeze 0.010
        jog_ignore_metric 0.007
        max_opc_move 0.05
        max_iter_movement 0.005

        layer METAL_TARGET opc
        # A hidden layer is not simulated.  SRAF must use the documented
        # sraf type so sraf_print_avoidance can detect and correct printing.
        layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL sraf

        image /
        pw_condition SRAF_PRINT dose 1 spa

        feedback_mode 1
        displacement_limit_mode STRICT

        fragment_min 0.025
        line_end_fragment off
        fragment_layer_order full
        fragment_max 0.060 -minlen 0.200
        fragment_corner convex convex length > 0.050 < 0.100 fragment breakinhalf

        fragment_layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL {

        mrc_rule external METAL_TARGET METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule internal METAL_TARGET { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule internal METAL_SRAF_INITIAL { use 0.02 euclidean }
        mrc_rule area METAL_SRAF_INITIAL {

            square use 0.0004
        }

        OPC_ITERATION 5

        OPC_ITERATION 1
        sraf_print_avoidance -layer METAL_SRAF_INITIAL -step 0.001
        OPC_ITERATION 1
